0022600094.text: The Atlanta Hawks (1-0, 1st in the Southeast, 3rd in the East) are on the road against the Charlotte Hornets (1-0, 3rd in the Southeast, 6th in the East), with both teams unbeaten so far and this being the Hawks' second game of the season. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). In the 2025-26 season series the Hawks lost 1-3, including a 110-107 loss in Charlotte on February 11, 2026, and no games between the teams have been played yet in 2026-27.
